title: Deep Residual Learning — 2015 Public Preprint Milestone
summary: On 10 December 2015, Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang, Shaoqing Ren, and Jian Sun submitted the public arXiv preprint "Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition." The paper presents a residual learning framework for training substantially deeper neural networks and reports residual networks evaluated at depths up to 152 layers on ImageNet.
significance: A directly identifiable public documentation milestone for deep residual learning and residual networks. LINEAiGE records the dated preprint milestone without treating it as an invention date, a universal system-birth date, or evidence of causal influence on later systems.

verification.note: The arXiv record gives the title, authors, and first-submission timestamp of 10 December 2015. The author paper and Microsoft Research publication record describe the residual learning framework and its ImageNet experiments. This candidate is limited to the public preprint/documentation milestone and does not infer an invention date, first implementation date, universal priority, unsupported geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.
